I made both changes.

- **Title wave:** each letter of the title bobs up and down in turn, so a wave rolls across it from left to right. The neon flicker at load and the sputtering "o" in "Robot" still work. The title can still wrap between words if the page gets narrow, but never in the middle of a word. Screen readers still read it as the normal title.
- **Jelly buttons:** when you hover over "Get it" or "GitHub", the button squashes, stretches and settles back, like jelly. Those are the only two buttons on the page.

**What I checked after reloading:** I measured the letter heights and saw the wave travelling across the title, and confirmed it in a screenshot. I can't hover the mouse from here, so I tested the wobble by running its animation on "Get it" directly, and it squashed as expected. I haven't seen a real hover myself. Neither mod reported any errors.

If your system is set to reduce motion, the wave and wobble are switched off.

The wave is part of the **Neon title** mod. The wobble is a new, separate mod, **Jelly buttons**, so you can switch either one off in the side panel.
